title: Computing Igusa's local zeta functions of univariate polynomials, and linear feedback shift registers
notes: Attaches a tree T(f, l_f) of p-adic root approximations to a univariate f and computes the local zeta function from its generating function. The lifting tree is a known object. The local-vs-global triage uses this as the generating-function side of Igusa, not as a new bound. docs/theory/local_vs_global_stabilization.md.
